method: Conventional Bayesian causal graph-response filter with learned graph prior and posterior predictive one-step paid diagnostic value-of-information planning, graph change-point mixture, hypothesis world model; no tokens or neural integration

hypothesis_grammar.parents_per_internal_node: 1 with probability 1/3 else 2; uniform without replacement from earlier nodes
hypothesis_grammar.gates: PASS for one parent, uniform AND/OR/XOR for two
hypothesis_grammar.filter: all-zero ambient and exactly one actuator-on intervention reaches F=1
hypothesis_grammar.deduplication: full eight-action six-bit response signature, preserve first encountered graph
hypothesis_grammar.no_named_holdout_templates: Hypotheses generated from universal DAG grammar without importing motif definitions or actual hidden graph

physical_training.label_custody: Only World.observe and charged World.step transitions; no private graph, future, seed or oracle in learner
physical_training.train_order: ascending seeds; do not reorder based on results

bayes_training.underflow: normalized likelihood with logspace max-shift per segment
bayes_training.checkpoint: deterministic JSON with hypothesis signatures and learned weights

planner.tie_break: lexicographic diagnostic then smallest actuator index
planner.no_graph_access: Policy sees only observe and step returns
planner.action_horizon: one-step expected value of info; rerun after each charged probe

negative_controls: No official seed accepted in physical-world constructor
Fitted prior differs from uniform on nontrivial training
Private graph and motif not passed into posterior updates or action selection
No free diagnostic, no copied world, no reward from diagnostic
Across-OS equality of model weights and public physical receipts
pending: Fully trained recurrent world model control
Matched training/convergence and larger compute control comparisons
scope: Only preliminary synthetic engineering qualification; not official DEV, cold or registered evaluation, SCIENTIFIC_PASS, or integration/promotion. No main, runner, controller, scheduled tasks, merge or native Yggdrasil model changes.
